title: Efficacy of Acupuncture and Bee Venom Acupuncture on Patients With Idiopathic Parkinson's Disease
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of acupuncture and bee venom acupuncture (BVA) for idiopathic Parkinson's disease (IPD) through a sham-controlled trial and investigate whether there is sustainability of treatments effects by follow-up assessments after the end of the treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with IPD who have been on a stable dose of anti-parkinsonian medication for at least one month.
* Hoehn \& Yahr scale I-IV
* More than one point in two or more items (tremor, rigidity, postural instability, and bradykinesia) in the UPDRS Part III, etc.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe psychiatric or organic brain disorders other than PD, previous or current
* Secondary Parkinsonism due to cerebrovascular disease, tumor, infection, etc.
* Atypical Parkinsonian or Parkinson plus syndrome
